purpose: Test whether bounding the number of individually admissible V98 band8 LoadLeast substitutions applied in one scheduling window prevents aggregate workflow-completion regressions while retaining the cross-scenario QPR benefit over the frozen V94 anchor.

revealed_diagnosis.mechanistic_hypothesis: The complete-assignment certificate proves same-window nonworsening in routed, OCS, LoadLeast, and immutable-baseline welfare scores, but it does not model downstream DAG completion. Applying several individually eligible structural moves in one SRPT-ready pass can accumulate a larger state perturbation than a single certified move. The uniquely harmful pulse E827 pair contained 17 accepted multi-substitution windows, including eight windows with at least three substitutions. A fixed per-window cap is therefore a narrow stability intervention that preserves the frozen scoring and certificate while bounding state displacement.
revealed_diagnosis.causal_limit: V98 logs identify association, not the counterfactual performance of capped execution. V99 therefore treats cap1 and cap2 as preregistered fresh-seed training arms rather than reconstructing outcomes from V98 logs.

closed_alternatives.terminal_specific_relaxation: not pursued because V98 recorded zero terminal substitutions; further terminal-score relaxation would change a second factor without evidence that the path can pass the frozen certificate
closed_alternatives.density_retuning: not pursued because beneficial and harmful V98 windows overlap strongly in density, including the 48-to-64 band
closed_alternatives.performance_aware_or_scenario_aware_cap: forbidden because workload label, completion, throughput, and QPR are outside the online information boundary

allowed_online_inputs: current pending plus resident task count by node
current feasible nodes and warm-container state
frozen terminal-OCS or nonterminal-FaaSRank routed score and history
number of structural substitutions already selected in the current scheduling window

arms.queue_density_range: [8,64) for nonterminal players and [0,64) for terminal players
[8,64) for nonterminal players and [0,64) for terminal players

candidate_mechanism.player_order: retain the exact V94 SRPT-ready order
candidate_mechanism.eligible_move: retain the exact V98 band8 per-player lower-projected-load and routed-score-nonworse eligibility rule
candidate_mechanism.cap_semantics: scan the frozen player order once; accept eligible substitutions until the arm cap is reached; every later player is assigned its frozen anchor node for that window
complete_initializer_acceptance: at least one and at most the arm-specific number of structural substitutions
candidate_mechanism.coordination_acceptance: retain the V94 dual window-safe Pareto guard and additionally require a nonworse complete-assignment LoadLeast score
candidate_mechanism.cap_provenance: 1 is the smallest nonzero structural perturbation; 2 is the next integer sensitivity value. Both were fixed before V99 implementation or input generation. No cap is selected from V99 until the complete paired cohort is revealed.

selection.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection.E3_winner_requires: one candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection.multiple_passers: maximize the minimum relative mean QPR gain across all three scenarios and both conventions, then maximize the minimum relative throughput change, then smaller cap, then arm_id
selection.frozen_E4_component: V97 v97-e4-load-guard64; no V99 E4 arm or result-dependent E4 reselection
selection.E3_pass_authorizes_only: a separately committed E886-E905 all-20-seed confirmation plan pairing the selected E3 profile with the already frozen V97 E4 profile
selection.failure_action: Freeze all 27 runs, keep every reserved or confirmation seed untouched, do not replace seeds or selectively rerun scientific results, and return to mechanism diagnosis.
